title: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer — CSA Food Production Crosswalk

evidence_policy.direct_reference: A documented educational reference directly relevant to the mission's learning activity; not necessarily experimental evidence.
evidence_policy.supporting: A useful supporting educational reference that does not directly measure the simulated mission outcome.
evidence_policy.background_only: Contextual information for learning, not evidence for a simulated operational or health outcome.
evidence_policy.optional: An optional reference that may be used in an activity but is not part of the core mission mapping.

simulation_boundary: CSA educational references do not establish crop performance in lunar or Martian environments.
Do not infer crop yields, water consumption, energy consumption, or nutritional sufficiency without supporting data.
Do not invent numerical water-recovery rates.
Player resource inventories, crop yields, and greenhouse outcomes must remain labelled as simulations.
CSA water-recovery material does not establish general waste sorting or processing performance.
